description: REAR GARDEN - T1 to T7		T1 - Copper Beech (Fagus sylvatica purpurea) Reduce crown to the most recent previous reduction points, removing approx. 2m of new growth.Final height 8m and final overall spread 9m.T2 - Purple Leafed Plum (Prunus cerasifera 'Pissardii')	Reduce crown to the most recent previous reduction points, removing approx. 1.5-2m of new growth. Final height 5m and final overall spread 4m. T3 - Purple Leafed Plum (Prunus cerasifera 'Pissardii')	Reduce crown to the most recent previous reduction points, removing approx. 2m of new growth. Final height 5m and final overall spread 4m. 	T4 - Damson (Prunus insititia)	Reduce crown to the most recent previous reduction points, removing approx. 1.5-2m of new growth.Final height 5m and final overall spread 4m. 	T5 - Cherry (Prunus spp) Reduce crown to the most recent previous reduction points, removing approx. 1-1.5m of new growth.Final height 4m and final overall spread 3m. 	T6 - Weeping Willow (Salix babylonica) Re-Pollard back to previous pollard points removing approximately 3-4m of new growth.Final height 7m and spread 7m.	T7 - Snake Bark Maple (Acer capillipes) Reduce crown to the most recent previous reduction points, removing approx. 1.5-2m of new growth.Final height 4m and final overall spread 4m. 	See 2025/02506/TPO - Pruning of 2no. Lime trees in the front garden, subject to Tree Preservation Order TPO/18/2/70, by re-pollarding back to previous pollard points removing approximately 2-3m of new growth.
borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
